QuestInfo.name: I Need Help on My Homework!
QuestInfo.parent: I Need Help on My Homework!
QuestInfo.0: Whenever I walk past #p309# in #m10002000#, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder why...
QuestInfo.1: #p309# of #m10002000# seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I'd expect from someone asking for a FAVOR. Well, he asked me to get him #b10 #t4000011#s#k, #b10 #t4000006#s#k, and #b3 #t4000007#s#k. They're ingredients for a potion he was assigned to make for homework.
QuestInfo.2: I helped #p309# of #m10002000# with his homework. I have no idea what that potion is for, though.

0.0: Hey there, human! Do you have any time on your hands? If not, then oh well... I have something to ask you... Well, not really ask, but I need a favor. Are you interested...?

yes.0: There's this teacher in Magic School that scares the daylights out of everyone. I mean, he's as scary as they come. Anyway, he gave us homework to make a potion, but I'm swamped with so much homework from other classes that I don't know if I can do it.
yes.1: I need #b10 #t4000011#s#k, #b10 #t4000006#s#k, and #b3 #t4000007#s#k. Please get me those immediately!
yes.2: What's the potion going to be used for? That's none of your business. Know this, though. If you get me the ingredients, I will reward you well for your effort. I can't stand owing anything to a human.

no.0: Fine, I don't care! I can always find someone else!

1.0: Oh, you got them all! I need to make this potion fast and get on with my other homework. I think I can finish all of it thanks to you. Here are some potions and scrolls I made earlier. I don't need them, so you should take them.

yes.0: I don't need you now, so please leave!

item.0: I don't think you've gathered them all up. Hurry up, I don't have much time. I have to start memorizing spells once I'm done with my potions homework!
